assembly_instructions: 1) Lay the 0.95 m scaled lower carbon sandwich plate at y=0.155, align the visible relief-hole markers, and bolt the four 5 mm scaled true-X arms to it with the eight inner and outer arm clamp screws. 2) Add the four aluminum frame standoffs at the plate corners, then fasten the split left and right top rails so the center stack remains open from above and from the ISO view. 3) Install the four 30.5 mm-pattern stack standoffs on the bottom plate, place the 4-in-1 ESC board first, add the flight-controller board above it, then add the VTX board on the upper spacers. 4) Route each copper three-phase wire bundle flat along its matching carbon arm and solder it from the ESC edge to the corresponding 2207 stator. 5) Bolt each 2207 stator to its arm tip with four visible M3 motor screws, drop the rotor bell and shaft over the stator, then install the prop hub, three pitched blades, tapered blade tips, swept-disc reference ring, and prop nut on each motor. 6) Assemble the FPV camera between the two camera side cheeks, set its body and lens about 30 degrees upward, install both pivot screws, and connect its signal lead to the flight controller. 7) Mount the rear TPU antenna block, route the VTX coax from the VTX board, and seat the angled 5.8 GHz antenna whip behind the airframe clear of the propeller discs. 8) Use the thin battery footprint on the top rails as the installed location, then inspect the staggered exploded six-cell LiPo pack above and aft, connect its lead to the XT60 connector, and tighten the hook-and-loop strap across the pack in the final build.

metadata.info: A 5-inch-class freestyle/racing FPV quadcopter on a carbon-fiber true-X frame, scaled approximately 14x from real dimensions for legibility.
facts: Wheelbase ~220 mm real, shown scaled to 2.20 m motor-to-motor across the diagonal.
5 inch propellers are 127 mm diameter real, shown as 1.27 m swept discs.
2207 brushless motors have 22 mm stator diameter and 7 mm stator height in real hardware.
The flight stack uses a 30.5 x 30.5 mm real M3 mounting pattern, shown as a 0.305 m square scaled pattern.
Carbon arms are about 5 mm thick real, shown as 0.06 m thick members for visibility.
Main carbon plates are about 2 mm thick real, shown as 0.04 to 0.05 m thick scaled plates.
Typical 6S 1300 mAh LiPo packs are about 75 x 35 x 35 mm real and 22.2 V nominal.
The FPV camera is canted about 30 degrees upward for high-speed forward flight.
Analog VTX antennas operate at 5.8 GHz and are placed aft to clear carbon and prop wash.
Ready-to-fly all-up mass is commonly 550 to 650 g for this 5-inch class.
sources: T-Motor F40 PRO II / 2207 brushless motor datasheet
Betaflight 4.x setup documentation for 30.5 mm flight-controller stacks
Joshua Bardwell, FPV Drone Build Guide, 2023

parts.name: Lower Carbon Sandwich Plate
parts.role: Thin lower carbon plate that clamps the four arms and provides the root of the electronics stack.

parts.name: Front Lower Plate Relief Hole Marker
parts.role: Bright circular marker shows the front lightening cutout in the carbon bottom plate.

parts.name: Rear Lower Plate Relief Hole Marker

parts.name: Left Lower Plate Relief Hole Marker

parts.name: Right Lower Plate Relief Hole Marker
parts.role: Bright circular marker shows the starboard-side lightening cutout in the carbon bottom plate.

parts.name: Left Split Top Rail
parts.role: Left upper carbon rail clamps the frame while leaving the flight stack visible from above.

parts.name: Left Top Rail Slot Marker
parts.role: Bright slot marker identifies the lightened cut carbon rail instead of a solid bar.

parts.name: Right Split Top Rail
parts.role: Right upper carbon rail clamps the frame while keeping the central boards exposed for the X-ray view.

parts.name: Right Top Rail Slot Marker
parts.role: Bright slot marker identifies the lightened cut carbon rail instead of a solid bar.

parts.name: Left Battery Flight Footprint
parts.role: Thin rail-top pad marks the installed LiPo location without covering the exposed electronics stack.

parts.name: Right Battery Flight Footprint
parts.role: Second thin rail-top pad completes the visible flight-position footprint for the exploded LiPo pack.

parts.name: Front-Left Carbon Arm
parts.role: Front-left 5 mm carbon arm carries the motor thrust load from the frame center to the tip.

parts.name: Rear-Right Carbon Arm

parts.name: Frame Standoff Front-Left

parts.name: Frame Standoff Front-Right
parts.role: Aluminum post setting the front-right gap between lower plate and top rail.

parts.name: Frame Standoff Rear-Left
parts.role: Aluminum post setting the rear-left gap between lower plate and top rail.

parts.name: Frame Standoff Rear-Right

parts.name: Stack Standoff Front-Left
parts.role: M3 stack spacer at the front-left 30.5 mm-pattern board mounting point.

parts.name: Stack Standoff Front-Right
parts.role: M3 stack spacer at the front-right 30.5 mm-pattern board mounting point.

parts.name: Stack Standoff Rear-Left

parts.name: Stack Standoff Rear-Right
parts.role: M3 stack spacer at the rear-right 30.5 mm-pattern board mounting point.

parts.name: 4-in-1 ESC Board
parts.role: Lowest electronics board switches battery current into three motor phases for each corner.

parts.name: Flight Controller Board
parts.role: Middle board reads the gyro and commands the ESC so the quadcopter stabilizes and responds to the radio.

parts.name: Video Transmitter Board
parts.role: Upper board modulates the camera feed onto a 5.8 GHz radio signal for the pilot.

parts.name: ESC Direction Mark
parts.role: Bright mark on the ESC board showing the forward orientation and making the lowest board readable.

parts.name: Flight Controller Gyro Chip
parts.role: Central MEMS gyro package whose position identifies the flight-controller board function.

parts.name: VTX Heat Sink
parts.role: Small metal heat spreader on the VTX board that represents the RF power stage.

parts.name: Left Camera Side Plate
parts.role: Left TPU cheek protects the FPV camera without hiding its body from the ISO view.

parts.name: Right Camera Side Plate
parts.role: Right TPU cheek protects the FPV camera without forming an opaque cage block.

parts.name: Left Camera Pivot Screw
parts.role: Side screw that fixes the camera tilt angle in the left cheek plate.

parts.name: Right Camera Pivot Screw
parts.role: Side screw that fixes the camera tilt angle in the right cheek plate.

parts.name: FPV Camera Body
parts.role: Analog CMOS micro camera body tilted upward so the pilot sees level horizon during fast forward flight.

parts.name: Wide-Angle Camera Lens
parts.role: M12 wide-angle lens protrudes from the tilted camera and defines the forward viewing direction.

parts.name: Camera Signal Lead
parts.role: Flexible signal cable carrying camera video and power back to the flight controller.

parts.name: Rear Antenna TPU Mount
parts.role: Rear printed mount grips the antenna base and keeps it out of the propeller discs.

parts.name: VTX Coax Lead
parts.role: Short coaxial cable carries RF output from the VTX board to the rear antenna mount.

parts.name: 5.8 GHz Antenna Whip
parts.role: Angled circular-polarized antenna radiates the analog video downlink behind the airframe.

parts.name: XT60 Power Connector
parts.role: Yellow XT60 connector marks the removable high-current battery connection to the ESC board.

parts.name: Exploded Battery Lead
parts.role: Power lead shown lifted with the exploded LiPo so the XT60 connection path remains visible.

parts.name: Exploded LiPo Cell 1
parts.role: Lowest pouch cell of the 6S LiPo pack, staggered upward and aft to expose the flight stack.

parts.name: Exploded LiPo Cell 2
parts.role: Second pouch cell is offset so the cell layer remains visible in the exploded pack.

parts.name: Exploded LiPo Cell 3
parts.role: Third pouch cell shows the layered battery construction instead of a single opaque block.

parts.name: Exploded LiPo Cell 4
parts.role: Fourth pouch cell in the six-cell 22.2 V nominal LiPo pack.

parts.name: Exploded LiPo Cell 5
parts.role: Fifth pouch cell continues the staggered visible construction of the LiPo pack.

parts.name: Exploded LiPo Cell 6
parts.role: Top pouch cell completes the exploded 6S pack while staying clear of the electronics view.

parts.name: LiPo Balance Lead End Cap
parts.role: Soft end cap represents the wire-exit end of the staggered LiPo pouch stack.

parts.name: Exploded Hook-and-Loop Strap
parts.role: Strap shown above the exploded LiPo to indicate it wraps across the pack and ties into both top rails.
